# Require Name On Principles And Constraints

Principles and constraints now require a name field, the same as every other element, instead of being a bare key: statement string. Engineering.Principles/Constraints changed from OrderedMap[string] to OrderedMap[NamedStatement]{Name, Statement}; the schema's statementMap now requires a {name, statement} object. Named this repo's own two principles and two constraints and rebuilt docs -- their headings and anchors now read as real names instead of the raw key.

**Rationale:**

The 'keyed but shapeless' design meant a principle or constraint's generated heading and GitHub anchor fell back to its raw key (e.g. 'single-go-binary' instead of 'Single Go Binary'), the only elements in the tree without a readable heading. Requiring name -- rather than making it optional -- keeps every element in the tree uniformly shaped, avoiding a permanent two-shape special case for these two kinds.
